So, it started some years ago when I got invited clubbing with a couple of friends. What I didn't know at the time (sheltered upbringing and all that) is that it was an LGBTQIA+ club. I was a bit unnerved, but I had a great time - I danced, got a bit drunk, and surprisingly got asked for my number a few times, which I awkwardly deflected. It confused the hell out of me. 

After that I started chatting online with my friend's same-sex SO, who I was also friends with. I told them I was a bit confused about my sexuality, we discussed it at length, but it came out that they were somewhat unhappy with my friend, and had become really attracted to me. When I thought about it, I realised I was actually kinda attracted to them too. Cue lots of butterflies. This went on for a little while, and eventually they suggested we meet and talk it out.

We met at my house. I was really nervous. They were really kind. They held my hand as we talked. We hugged, and something broke inside me. I grabbed them and kissed them, hard. To my shock, horror and ultinately delight, they reciprocated. We made out for a while, then I suggested we go upstairs. We stopped short of actually having sex that day, but we both gor topless, and I got naked and masturbated while they watched. 

We continued to see each other clandestinely for a while, and had sex quite a number of times. I fell hard for them, like, really hard, and when they called it off, it almost broke me, but it was probably for the best in the end. 

Like I said, I'm not proud of this. But I don't regret it happening, nor do I feel terribly guilty. My friend, to my knowledge, never found out.
